description: Only ASCII whitespace is trimmed from a level value. A no-break space before debug is not trimmed, and U+001C (whitespace to str.strip(), not to ASCII) does not make a value blank: both are unknown, warn with the raw value quoted (no escape for either character) and keep their defaults.
